tools.name: list_clinics
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which vet clinics they manage in Veterical, or a clinic's id is needed. Returns each clinic's id, name, currency, default language and timezone, 20 per page by default. Not for finding a pet, owner or appointment.

tools.name: get_clinic
tools.description: Use this when someone asks about one vet clinic's basic settings, such as its currency, language or timezone. Returns the clinic's name, currency, default language, timezone and last edit time; an id outside the organization returns not-found. Not for free appointment slots.

tools.name: get_clinic_availability
tools.description: Use this when someone asks when their vet clinic has free appointment slots or openings. Returns the open online-booking slots per day for one clinic: how many, plus the first start and last end time. Covers the next days that have openings, up to 14 days and 100 slots (no pet, owner or medical data

tools.name: list_clinic_providers
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which vets, nurses or assistants can be booked at their clinic. Returns up to 100 staff display names for one clinic (no contact details, roles or pet data). Not for staff days off or vacations.

tools.name: get_clinic_schedule_summary
tools.description: Use this when someone asks how busy their vet clinic is or how many appointments fall on each day. Returns appointment counts per UTC day for one clinic, canceled ones included, for the next 7 days by default and at most 31 days; counting stops at 100. tools.name: list_calendar_events
tools.description: Use this when someone asks when their vet clinic is closed or has time blocked for holidays, vacations, sick days, meetings or courses. Returns each block or extra opening with start, end, all-day flag, scope (clinic, staff or room) and type, without titles, notes or names. Not for appointments.

tools.name: list_procedures
tools.description: Use this when someone asks about the prices set in their vet clinic's treatment and service catalog, such as the lowest, highest or most recently changed price. Returns price, duration where recorded and last edit time per catalog row, without treatment names. Not for the price of a specific named t

tools.name: list_payments
tools.description: Use this when someone asks how much their vet clinic has taken in, or how many payments succeeded, failed or were canceled. tools.name: list_subscriptions
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which Veterical plan their clinic is on, whether it is active, or how many users, seats, patients or appointments it allows. Returns plan name, status, billing frequency and plan caps per subscription; caps are limits, not usage. Not for invoices or amounts billed.

tools.name: show_clinic_overview
tools.description: Use this when someone wants a quick overview or dashboard of one vet clinic. Returns an overview card with the clinic's details, appointment counts for the next 7 days, how many staff can be booked, open online-booking slots and up to 12 catalog prices (no pet, owner or medical data). tools.name: open_veterical
tools.description: Use this when someone wants to open Veterical and browse their clinics, aggregate schedule counts, booking availability and catalog prices in an interactive sidebar.
